summary: Master cloud storage and digital archiving. Learn cost optimization, OAIS standards, and data lifecycle management in this 5-day expert-led course.
lede: Cloud Storage and Digital Archiving Strategies provides a structured way to manage unstructured data throughout its lifecycle, helping you address data fragmentation and the hidden costs of unmanaged cloud growth. You will learn to classify data by value, automate tiering with lifecycle policies, apply metadata schemas and retention rules, and support long-term readability through format migration. The course combines practitioner-focused configuration with resilience and cost management, covering cloud buckets, storage classes, block storage, archive tiers, and cost-benefit analysis. You will also practise the 3-2-1-1-0 backup rule, AES-256 encryption at rest, Object Lock, cross-region replication, and large-scale migration using AWS Snowball or Azure Data Box.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals responsible for the long-term stewardship of digital assets and the optimization of cloud infrastructure costs.
modules: Foundations of Modern Cloud Storage Architecture
Digital Archiving Standards and the OAIS Model
Storage Tiering and Cost Optimization Strategies
Large-Scale Data Migration and Hybrid Integration
prerequisites: Participants should have an intermediate understanding of IT infrastructure and basic familiarity with at least one major cloud service provider (AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud). Experience with data management concepts, such as file systems, databases, or backup software, is highly recommended. No advanced programming skills are required, but a basic understanding of command-line interfaces (CLI) and JSON for policy configuration will be beneficial.
